headline: Economists Warn of Potential 2027 Recession Risks in Brazil Amid High Interest Rates
summary: Economists in Brazil are raising concerns over high interest rates, deteriorating expectations, and rising delinquency rates, warning of a potential recession risk in 2027 despite current GDP growth projections.
why: Elevated borrowing costs and tightening credit conditions often threaten future economic growth and corporate earnings cycles.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Macroeconomic headwinds and high interest rates pose growth risks for the Brazilian economy.
